sections.title: Laravel Content Lifecycle
sections.description: Select a ContentForge-managed Laravel pack, then manage its Compose lifecycle.

fields.label: Content Pack
fields.description: Choose a locally registered Laravel ContentForge pack.

validations.message: A ContentForge content pack ID is required.

fields.label: Runtime Status
fields.description: Use Refresh Status to query the Laravel Compose service.

fields.label: Selected Content
fields.description: Pack metadata is refreshed after a lifecycle or status action.

fields.label: Start Content
fields.description: Start the selected local Compose stack through DockerOrchestrator.

fields.label: Stop Content
fields.description: Stop the selected local Compose services without removing volumes.

fields.label: Refresh Status
fields.description: Check whether the Laravel application service is running.

sections.title: Nova ID Login
sections.description: Remote control requires a Nova ID OAuth device session. Credential materialization is owned by KeyForge; tokens never appear in this menu.

fields.label: Nova ID Status
fields.description: Login becomes available after KeyForge can materialize the OAuth app credentials for the configured device flow.

fields.label: Login API URL
fields.description: This URL is safe to open or copy into Postman. It contains only a short-lived login session identifier, never a token.
fields.defaultValue: Login URL: Waiting for KeyForge OAuth credential materialization

fields.label: Start OAuth Device Login
fields.description: Fails closed until KeyForge can safely materialize the dedicated Celestia OAuth app credentials.

fields.label: Refresh Login
fields.description: Queues a non-blocking device-token poll after a device login has been started.

fields.label: Forget Local Session
fields.description: Removes the in-memory Nova ID token from Celestia Nova. It does not revoke the API-side token.

sections.title: Remote VM Lifecycle
sections.description: Uses the selected pack's declarative SSH target. SSH agent authentication and a verified host key are mandatory.

fields.label: Remote Status
fields.description: Remote actions are queued and never block menu rendering.

fields.label: Bootstrap Remote VM
fields.description: Install and enable Docker using passwordless sudo on the selected VM.

fields.label: Stage Remote Release
fields.description: Upload a ContentForge materialized release. Secrets and .env files are excluded.

fields.label: Refresh Remote Status
fields.description: Query the active remote Compose release over verified SSH.
